name: Kalshi
tagline: Reads one event contract and lays out thesis, size and risk plainly
description: A narrow research desk for a single event-outcome market. Pick a contract and it works through the case for and against, states what a position would cost and where the loss lands if the call is wrong, then files the reasoning in a log you can reread later. It informs a decision rather than making one for you.
author: WorkWithJodi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
